assert(game.Name == "AEGIS_Reactor.rbxlx")
local H = game:GetService("HttpService")
local st = workspace.REACTOR_MESH_ASSEMBLY.STATIC
local kit = st:FindFirstChild("DAMAGE_PIPE_RUPTURE_KIT_01")
assert(kit, "kit yok")
local out = {kitAttr = kit:GetAttribute("Faz4Generated"), spools = {}}
local totalMesh, totalAnch = 0, 0
for _, m in ipairs(kit:GetChildren()) do
	local sp = {name = m.Name, spoolId = m:GetAttribute("SpoolId"), parts = {}, allHidden = true, allNoCollide = true, anchors = {}}
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
			totalMesh += 1
			sp.parts[#sp.parts + 1] = d.Name
			if d.Transparency ~= 1 then sp.allHidden = false end
			if d.CanCollide or d.CanQuery or d.CanTouch then sp.allNoCollide = false end
		elseif d.Name == "MOUTH_A" or d.Name == "MOUTH_B" then
			totalAnch += 1
			local cf = d.CFrame
			sp.anchors[d.Name] = {pos = {cf.Position.X, cf.Position.Y, cf.Position.Z}, look = {cf.LookVector.X, cf.LookVector.Y, cf.LookVector.Z}}
		end
	end
	local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
	sp.bbox = {c = {cf.Position.X, cf.Position.Y, cf.Position.Z}, s = {sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z}}
	out.spools[#out.spools + 1] = sp
end
out.totalMeshParts = totalMesh
out.totalAnchors = totalAnch
local intact = st.REACTOR_COOLANT_PIPING_RING_01:FindFirstChild("PIPE_SPOOL_UPPER_LEFT")
if intact then
	local cf, sz = intact:GetBoundingBox()
	out.intactUL = {c = {cf.Position.X, cf.Position.Y, cf.Position.Z}, s = {sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z}}
end
local nMesh = 0
for _, d in ipairs(workspace.REACTOR_MESH_ASSEMBLY:GetDescendants()) do
	if d:IsA("MeshPart") then nMesh += 1 end
end
out.assemblyMeshParts = nMesh
return H:JSONEncode(out)
